cards.ex: She was seething with anger after the argument, but tried to remain calm.
cards.exUz: U bahsdan keyin g'azabdan qaynab turardi, lekin xotirjam bo'lishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli g'azab hissini ichga yutib, tashqariga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: He's been plagued by doubt ever since he made that decision.
cards.exUz: U bu qarorni qabul qilganidan beri doimiy shubhalar bilan qiynalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy shubhalar tufayli azob chekish, tinchlik yo'qotish.

cards.ex: A surge of joy washed over her when she saw her family.
cards.exUz: Oila a'zolarini ko'rganda uni xursandchilik to'lqini qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'lgan kuchli va kutilmagan xursandchilik hissi.

cards.ex: I felt a pang of guilt for not calling my grandmother more often.
cards.exUz: Men buvimga tez-tez qo'ng'iroq qilmaganim uchun o'zimni aybdor his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'lgan kuchli aybdorlik hissi, achinish.

cards.ex: The election results were a bitter disappointment for his supporters.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalari uning tarafdorlari uchun achchiq umidsizlik bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va yoqimsiz umidsizlik, qattiq xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's been beset by anxiety about her upcoming exams.
cards.exUz: U yaqinlashib kelayotgan imtihonlar haqida doimo tashvishda.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy tashvishlar bilan kurashish, tinimsiz xavotirda bo'lish.

cards.ex: There's a simmering resentment between the two departments.
cards.exUz: Ikki bo'lim o'rtasida ichki adovat bor.
cards.uzDef: Ichda asta-sekin o'sib borayotgan, lekin tashqariga chiqmagan adovat hissi.

cards.ex: He was overcome with grief after the loss of his wife.
cards.exUz: U xotinining vafotidan keyin motam bilan qamrab olindi.
cards.uzDef: Motam tufayli o'zini yo'qotib qo'yish, juda qattiq qayg'urish.

cards.ex: I had a sense of dread as I walked into the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvga kirganimda meni qo'rquv hissi qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi yomon voqea haqida noxush va qo'rqinchli his.

cards.ex: He was blinded by rage and couldn't think straight.
cards.exUz: U g'azabdan ko'r bo'lib, to'g'ri fikrlay olmadi.
cards.uzDef: G'azabdan aqlini yo'qotish, hech narsani ko'rmaslik.

cards.ex: They were plunged into utter despair after the flood destroyed their home.
cards.exUz: To'fon ularning uyini vayron qilganidan keyin ular mutlaq umidsizlikka tushib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chuqur va qattiq umidsizlik, hech qanday umid yo'qligi.

cards.ex: There's still a flicker of hope that they'll find a solution.
cards.exUz: Hali ham yechim topishlariga umid uchquni bor.
cards.uzDef: Kichik va zaif umid, yaxshilikka ishonch belgisi.

cards.ex: She's been wrestling with doubts about her career choice.
cards.exUz: U o'zining kasbiy tanlovi haqida shubhalar bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishda qiyinchiliklar va shubhalar bilan kurashish.

cards.ex: A wave of nostalgia washed over me as I looked at the old photos.
cards.exUz: Eski suratlarga qaraganimda meni sog'inch to'lqini qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga bo'lgan kuchli va kutilmagan sog'inch hissi.

cards.ex: The meeting was fraught with tension as everyone argued about the budget.
cards.exUz: Byudjet haqida hamma bahslashgani uchun yig'ilish keskinlik bilan to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Keskin vaziyat, stress va xavotir bilan to'lgan.

cards.ex: He was consumed by jealousy of his friend's success.
cards.exUz: U do'stining muvaffaqiyatiga hasad qilib, butunlay hasadga berilib ketgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Hasad hissi butun fikrini egallab olgan, hasadga berilib ketgan.

cards.ex: I have a grudging admiration for his tenacity, even though I disagree with him.
cards.exUz: Men unga rozi bo'lmasam ham, uning qat'iyatiga majburiy hayrat bilan qarayman.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga yoqmasa ham, tan olishga majbur bo'lgan hayrat hissi.

cards.ex: His anger was stoked by resentment over past injustices.
cards.exUz: Uning g'azabi o'tmishdagi adolatsizliklarga nisbatan adovat bilan qo'zg'atilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan mavjud bo'lgan adovatni kuchaytirish, adovatni olovlantirish.

cards.ex: The children were brimming with excitement about the trip to Disneyland.
cards.exUz: Bolalar Disneylendga sayohat qilishdan juda hayajonlanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va hayajonli holatda bo'lish, toshib ketayozgan quvonch.

cards.ex: She has a profound sense of responsibility towards her community.
cards.exUz: Uning jamiyat oldida chuqur mas'uliyat hissi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va muhim his, sezgi yoki tushuncha.

cards.ex: He's been in the doldrums since he lost his job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri tushkunlikda.
cards.uzDef: Tushkunlik holati, quvvatsizlik, g'ayrat yo'qligi.

cards.ex: She was choked with emotion as she accepted the award.
cards.exUz: U mukofotni qabul qilayotganda hissiylikka to'lib, gapira olmay qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlardan gapira olmay qolish, ko'z yoshlari kelishi.

cards.ex: He was seized with panic when he realized he'd lost his passport.
cards.exUz: U pasportini yo'qotganini anglab yetgach, vahima bilan qamrab olindi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan vahima hissi paydo bo'lishi, o'zini yo'qotib qo'yish.

cards.ex: There was a palpable tension in the room as the negotiations continued.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar davom etar ekan, xonada sezilarli keskinlik bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha seziladigan, yaqqol ko'rinib turgan keskin vaziyat.

cards.ex: He was wracked with guilt after lying to his friend.
cards.exUz: U do'stiga yolg'on gapirgandan keyin aybdorlikdan azob chekdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli aybdorlik hissi tufayli azoblanish, qiynalish.

cards.ex: He was blinded by ambition and didn't care who he hurt along the way.
cards.exUz: U mansabparastlikdan ko'r bo'lib, yo'lda kimga zarar yetkazayotganiga ahamiyat bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Mansabga intilish aqlini to'sib qo'ygan, boshqa narsani ko'rmaydigan.

cards.ex: Despite the setbacks, there's still a glimmer of hope for a positive outcome.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, ijobiy natijaga umid nur sochadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, lekin sezilarli umid; muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli.

cards.ex: She's been on an emotional rollercoaster since the breakup.
cards.exUz: U ajrashgandan beri hissiy uchuvchanlikda.
cards.uzDef: Tez-tez o'zgarib turadigan kuchli his-tuyg'ularni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: He's been beset by worries about his family's health.
cards.exUz: U oilasining sog'lig'i haqida doimo tashvishlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy tashvishlar va xavotirlar bilan kurashish.

cards.ex: She was lost in reverie, dreaming about her future.
cards.exUz: U xayolga cho'mgan, kelajagi haqida orzu qilardi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining xayollariga berilib ketish, atrofni unutish.
